NVIDIA SAYS JENSEN HUANG WILL REMAIN CEO AMID PROBE Nvidia ($NVDA ) says CEO Jensen Huang will continue leading the company without interruption, despite news of an investigation. In a message to employees, Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife, took full responsibility and pledged to rebuild trust. A Nvidia spokesperson emphasized that Huang remains fully committed to his role as CEO.

SPCX - STIFEL REITERATES BUY ON SPACEX WITH $190 PRICE TARGET Stifel maintains its Buy rating on SpaceX, arguing that tighter US data-center permitting could create new opportunities. With $40 billion in committed GPU financing, SpaceX could acquire stalled AI infrastructure projects with secured power access. The firm also sees growing potential for orbital computing, while Qualcomm's selection as a radio supplier strengthens SpaceX's mobile-network ambitions.

US OCTOBER CPI REPORT TO OMIT ANNUAL INFLATION FIGURES The Bureau of Labor Statistics will exclude year-over-year headline and core CPI figures from Tuesday's October inflation report. Missing October 2025 price data from last year's government shutdown prevents reliable annual comparisons. Annual real earnings growth will also be unavailable. Monthly inflation figures will still be released. Economists expect headline CPI to rise 0.3% MoM and core CPI to increase 0.2% MoM.
